_meta.batch: Moon CLUE X (~50 scen, 336 terminow) - reakcje Moon na kazdy dowod w grze pokazany jej do skomentowania (mechanika 'ask about clue'). Bogata nowa mitologia: Srebrny Waz/Waz z Silkwirm (morski waz zwiazany z Sylvia Seafoam, powod budowy pierwotnej lodzi Seafoam), Selena Stonetop jako malarka (inicjaly S.S.), Solomon Stonetop zalozyciel Silkwirm-on-sea, Faustus Fellow - Gubernator ktory wykupil miasteczko, Freya - tajemnicza postac z drzewa genealogicznego Moon, oraz KLUCZOWE odkrycie: ojciec Wirmana to 'burmistrz Damian Dusk' (wyjasnia watek 'Wirman zmienil imie' z Moon SUS Wirman - prawdopodobne rodowe nazwisko Wirmana to Dusk).
_meta.speaker_resolution: speaker_map.json (soulTalking) - wiekszosc pokryta bezposrednio, mowca 'Film' dla FilmProjector/ds8 (nagranie filmowe).
_meta.character_voice: Moon: kontynuacja poetyckiego/mistycznego, ale tu tez analitycznego (opisy zapachu/materialu przedmiotow - jej metoda 'wachania' dowodow) rejestru (batch_21-26, batch_50, batch_57).
_meta.new_lore: Srebrny Waz (Silversnake/Silkwirm Serpent) - legendarny morski waz odkryty przez Felicie Stonetop i Sylvie Seafoam (gazeta), ktorego Sylvia chciala zabrac ze soba na lodz podwodna Seafoam zanim wladze zazadaly przekazania go do badan. Solomon Stonetop zbudowal Gospode Stonetop i zalozyl miasteczko. Faustus Fellow (Gubernator) wykupil cale miasteczko.

Conversation/Moon CLUE ActionFigure/Sect.en: Yeah. That's what she's called in the book, too.
Conversation/Moon CLUE ActionFigure/Sect.pl: Tak. Tak samo nazywa się w książce.
Conversation/Moon CLUE ActionFigure/Sect.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Moon CLUE ActionFigure/Sect.en: Flying a little close to the [i]sun[/i] with that name, aren't they?
Conversation/Moon CLUE ActionFigure/Sect.pl: Trochę za blisko [i]słońca[/i] lecą z tym imieniem, nie sądzicie?
Conversation/Moon CLUE ActionFigure/Sect.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE BalloonBasket/Sec.en: Hmm, I'm getting mahogany... embedded with... sea salt.
Conversation/Moon CLUE BalloonBasket/Sec.pl: Hmm, wyczuwam mahoń... przesiąknięty... solą morską.
Conversation/Moon CLUE BalloonBasket/Sec.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE BalloonBasket/Sec.en: Maybe from when Gripp crashed his balloon into the ocean?
Conversation/Moon CLUE BalloonBasket/Sec.pl: Może z czasów, kiedy Gripp rozbił swój balon o ocean?
Conversation/Moon CLUE BalloonBasket/Sec.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Moon CLUE BalloonBasket/Sec.en: No, the basket is made from wicker and carbon fiber...
Conversation/Moon CLUE BalloonBasket/Sec.pl: Nie, kosz jest zrobiony z wikliny i włókna węglowego...
Conversation/Moon CLUE BalloonBasket/Sec.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE BalloonBasket/Sec.en: The wood [h]inside[/h] the basket - that's the mahogany.
Conversation/Moon CLUE BalloonBasket/Sec.pl: Drewno [h]wewnątrz[/h] kosza - to jest ten mahoń.
Conversation/Moon CLUE BalloonBasket/Sec.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE BlackBox/Section.en:
Really...
You're not even gonna tell us what it [i]smells[/i] like?
Conversation/Moon CLUE BlackBox/Section.pl:
Serio...
Nawet nie powiesz nam, jak to [i]pachnie?[/i]
Conversation/Moon CLUE BlackBox/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Moon CLUE BlackBox/Section.pl: [i]Starym mchem[/i] i [i]przesiąkniętym zazdrością dębem[/i] czy coś?
Conversation/Moon CLUE BlackBox/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Moon CLUE BlackBox/Section.en: She... still didn't actually tell us anything.
Conversation/Moon CLUE BlackBox/Section.pl: Ona... tak naprawdę wciąż nic nam nie powiedziała.
Conversation/Moon CLUE BlackBox/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Moon CLUE BlackBox/Section.en: I retract that 'aha' from the record.
Conversation/Moon CLUE BlackBox/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Moon CLUE BlurryPhoto/Secti.en: When did you take this photo?
Conversation/Moon CLUE BlurryPhoto/Secti.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Moon CLUE BlurryPhoto/Secti.en:
Says it right there-
On the [i]'night of a full moon'...[/i]
Conversation/Moon CLUE BlurryPhoto/Secti.pl:
Jest napisane właśnie tam-
W [i]'noc pełni księżyca'...[/i]
Conversation/Moon CLUE BlurryPhoto/Secti.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE BlurryPhoto/Secti.en: How come that guy has - glowing red eyes?
Conversation/Moon CLUE BlurryPhoto/Secti.pl: Czemu ten facet ma - świecące czerwone oczy?
Conversation/Moon CLUE BlurryPhoto/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Moon CLUE BlurryPhoto/Secti.en: Perhaps it's because of his [i]demonic essence...[/i]
Conversation/Moon CLUE BlurryPhoto/Secti.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE BlurryPhoto/Secti.en: Perhaps it's because I [i]used a flash...[/i]
Conversation/Moon CLUE BlurryPhoto/Secti.pl: Może to przez to, że [i]użyłam lampy błyskowej...[/i]
Conversation/Moon CLUE BlurryPhoto/Secti.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE BlurryPhoto/Secti.en: Who's the woman in the ball?
Conversation/Moon CLUE BlurryPhoto/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Moon CLUE BlurryPhoto/Secti.en: That's no woman! That's a mermaid! Slumbering in an ethereal bub-
Conversation/Moon CLUE BlurryPhoto/Secti.pl: To nie kobieta! To syrena! Drzemiąca w eterycznej ba-
Conversation/Moon CLUE BlurryPhoto/Secti.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE BlurryPhoto/Secti.en: You're not gonna tell us, huh?
Conversation/Moon CLUE BlurryPhoto/Secti.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Moon CLUE BrokenCompass/Sec.en: I never needed a compass - I prefer [h]old-fashioned[/h] methods of navigation.
Conversation/Moon CLUE BrokenCompass/Sec.pl: Nigdy nie potrzebowałam kompasu - wolę [h]staroświeckie[/h] metody nawigacji.
Conversation/Moon CLUE BrokenCompass/Sec.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE BrokenCompass/Sec.en: I'm pretty sure a compass [h]is[/h] the old-fashioned method.
Conversation/Moon CLUE BrokenCompass/Sec.pl: Jestem całkiem pewna, że kompas [h]jest[/h] staroświecką metodą.
Conversation/Moon CLUE BrokenCompass/Sec.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Moon CLUE BrokenCompass/Sec.en: Not as old as the sun and stars...
Conversation/Moon CLUE BrokenCompass/Sec.pl: Nie tak starą jak słońce i gwiazdy...
Conversation/Moon CLUE BrokenCompass/Sec.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE BrokenCompass/Sec.en: ...and unlike this compass, they never break and need repairing.
Conversation/Moon CLUE BrokenCompass/Sec.pl: ...i w przeciwieństwie do tego kompasu, nigdy się nie psują i nie wymagają naprawy.
Conversation/Moon CLUE BrokenCompass/Sec.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE BrokenCompass/Sec.en: I'm not sure it [h]is[/h] broken, actually.
Conversation/Moon CLUE BrokenCompass/Sec.pl: Właściwie, nie jestem pewien, czy [h]jest[/h] zepsuty.
Conversation/Moon CLUE BrokenCompass/Sec.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Moon CLUE CaptainsJacket/Se.en: Emblazoned with the Seafoam [i]'S'[/i], I see. It's quite an elaborate-
Conversation/Moon CLUE CaptainsJacket/Se.pl: Ozdobiona [i]'S'[/i] rodu Seafoam, widzę. To dość wystawn-
Conversation/Moon CLUE CaptainsJacket/Se.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE CaptainsJacket/Se.en: Oh, how strange. It's never been worn.
Conversation/Moon CLUE CaptainsJacket/Se.pl: Ach, jak dziwnie. Nigdy nie był noszony.
Conversation/Moon CLUE CaptainsJacket/Se.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE CaptainsJacket/Se.en: Once or twice, at the very most.
Conversation/Moon CLUE CaptainsJacket/Se.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE CaptainsLog/Secti.en: I'd heard Mortuga wasn't one for [i]writing things down[/i], so I'd given up hope of finding a diary-
Conversation/Moon CLUE CaptainsLog/Secti.pl: Słyszałam, że Mortuga nie był typem, który [i]spisuje rzeczy,[/i] więc porzuciłam nadzieję na znalezienie dziennika-
Conversation/Moon CLUE CaptainsLog/Secti.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE CaptainsLog/Secti.en: -but this might be the next best thing.
Conversation/Moon CLUE CaptainsLog/Secti.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE CaptainsLog/Secti.en: He made a record of every time a new person joined the submarine.
Conversation/Moon CLUE CaptainsLog/Secti.pl: Zapisywał każdy raz, kiedy nowa osoba dołączała do łodzi podwodnej.
Conversation/Moon CLUE CaptainsLog/Secti.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Moon CLUE CaptainsLog/Secti.en: Well, I suppose he never had the chance.
Conversation/Moon CLUE CaptainsLog/Secti.pl: Cóż, chyba nigdy nie miał okazji.
Conversation/Moon CLUE CaptainsLog/Secti.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE CaretakersJournal.pl: ...medalion lilian... srebrny wąż... złota dłoń... syre-
Conversation/Moon CLUE CaretakersJournal.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE CaretakersJournal.en: Only the name... and only when people were telling me it doesn't exist.
Conversation/Moon CLUE CaretakersJournal.pl: Tylko nazwę... i tylko wtedy, kiedy ludzie mówili mi, że nie istnieje.
Conversation/Moon CLUE CaretakersJournal.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE CaretakersJournal.en: What's it supposed to do, anyway? The description in the book here is pretty vague...
Conversation/Moon CLUE CaretakersJournal.pl: Co to w ogóle ma robić? Opis w tej książce jest dość niejasny...
Conversation/Moon CLUE CaretakersJournal.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Moon CLUE CaretakersJournal.en: Hm, they say it allows humans to commune directly with God, while they're still alive.
Conversation/Moon CLUE CaretakersJournal.pl: Hm, mówią, że pozwala ludziom obcować bezpośrednio z Bogiem, póki jeszcze żyją.
Conversation/Moon CLUE CaretakersJournal.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE CaretakersJournal.en: You know, it varies. But the sentiment is the same.
Conversation/Moon CLUE CaretakersJournal.pl: No wiesz, to się różni. Ale sens jest ten sam.
Conversation/Moon CLUE CaretakersJournal.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE CaretakersJournal.en: I can see why people would say it doesn't exist.
Conversation/Moon CLUE CaretakersJournal.pl: Rozumiem, czemu ludzie mówiliby, że to nie istnieje.
Conversation/Moon CLUE CaretakersJournal.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Moon CLUE CaretakersJournal.en: ...in here it says; [i]'Said to facilitate communication with She Who Lies Beyond The Veil.'[/i]
Conversation/Moon CLUE CaretakersJournal.pl: ...tu jest napisane; [i]'Podobno umożliwia komunikację z Tą, Która Leży Poza Zasłoną.'[/i]
Conversation/Moon CLUE CaretakersJournal.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Moon CLUE CaretakersJournal.en: [i]She Who Lies Beyond The Veil, God, Other Dimensions, Aliens, The Afterlife...[/i]
Conversation/Moon CLUE CaretakersJournal.pl: [i]Ta, Która Leży Poza Zasłoną, Bóg, Inne Wymiary, Kosmici, Zaświaty...[/i]
Conversation/Moon CLUE CaretakersJournal.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE CaretakersJournal.en: -but [i]Zephyr's[/i] trying to get hold of it?
Conversation/Moon CLUE CaretakersJournal.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Moon CLUE CaretakersJournal.en: It's a [i]wretched[/i] thing, really - an echo of Man's desperate, futile desire to wring answers from a [i]silent universe.[/i]
Conversation/Moon CLUE CaretakersJournal.pl: To [i]nędzna[/i] rzecz, doprawdy - echo rozpaczliwego, daremnego pragnienia Człowieka, by wydrzeć odpowiedzi z [i]milczącego wszechświata.[/i]
Conversation/Moon CLUE CaretakersJournal.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE CaseFile/Section.en: I see Sinthia's proudly wielding the Seafoam [i]'S'[/i] in her signature, there.
Conversation/Moon CLUE CaseFile/Section.pl: Widzę, że Sinthia dumnie posługuje się [i]'S'[/i] rodu Seafoam w swoim podpisie, tam.
Conversation/Moon CLUE CaseFile/Section.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE CaseFile/Section.en: Of course, she's well within her rights to do so-
Conversation/Moon CLUE CaseFile/Section.pl: Oczywiście, ma pełne prawo to robić-
Conversation/Moon CLUE CaseFile/Section.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE CaseFile/Section.en: But I do think, perhaps it, uh - sends a certain message?
Conversation/Moon CLUE CaseFile/Section.pl: Ale myślę, że może to, yy - wysyła pewien komunikat?
Conversation/Moon CLUE CaseFile/Section.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE CaseFile/Section.en: [i]'I claim this submarine in the name of the Seafoam family.'[/i]
Conversation/Moon CLUE CaseFile/Section.pl: [i]'Rości sobie tę łódź podwodną w imieniu rodu Seafoam.'[/i]
Conversation/Moon CLUE CaseFile/Section.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE CaseFile/Section.en: Something like that? Don't you think?
Conversation/Moon CLUE CaseFile/Section.pl: Coś w tym stylu? Nie sądzicie?
Conversation/Moon CLUE CaseFile/Section.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE CellPhone/Section.en: Polycarbonate shell, tactile interface, [i]unusually[/i] good battery life-
Conversation/Moon CLUE CellPhone/Section.pl: Poliwęglanowa obudowa, dotykowy interfejs, [i]niezwykle[/i] dobra żywotność baterii-
Conversation/Moon CLUE CellPhone/Section.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE CellPhone/Section.en:
I mean, uh-
It's... a cell phone.
Conversation/Moon CLUE CellPhone/Section.pl:
To znaczy, yy-
To... telefon komórkowy.
Conversation/Moon CLUE CellPhone/Section.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE CellPhone/Section.en: Hm. I suppose that makes the most sense...
Conversation/Moon CLUE CellPhone/Section.pl: Hm. Chyba to ma najwięcej sensu...
Conversation/Moon CLUE CellPhone/Section.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE CellPhone/Section.en: After all, Mortuga really didn't seem like the cell phone [i]type...[/i]
Conversation/Moon CLUE CellPhone/Section.pl: W końcu Mortuga naprawdę nie wyglądał na [i]typ[/i] od telefonów komórkowych...
Conversation/Moon CLUE CellPhone/Section.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE CommandContract/S.en: You know - one of the reasons I found it hard to research Mortuga, was that there really wasn't much of a [i]paper trail...[/i]
Conversation/Moon CLUE CommandContract/S.pl: Wiecie - jednym z powodów, dla których trudno mi było badać Mortugę, było to, że naprawdę nie było wielu [i]śladów papierkowych...[/i]
Conversation/Moon CLUE CommandContract/S.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE CommandContract/S.en: Well, seems like he changed his ways.
Conversation/Moon CLUE CommandContract/S.pl: Cóż, wygląda na to, że zmienił swoje nawyki.
Conversation/Moon CLUE CommandContract/S.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Moon CLUE CommandContract/S.en: Yes, it's rather odd, isn't it?
Conversation/Moon CLUE CommandContract/S.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE CommandContract/S.en: I wonder what compelled him to draw up a contract like this...
Conversation/Moon CLUE CommandContract/S.pl: Ciekawe, co skłoniło go do sporządzenia takiego kontraktu...
Conversation/Moon CLUE CommandContract/S.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE CommandContract/S.en: ...I can't help but feel like the idea must've come from someone else.
Conversation/Moon CLUE CommandContract/S.pl: ...nie mogę się oprzeć wrażeniu, że ten pomysł musiał pochodzić od kogoś innego.
Conversation/Moon CLUE CommandContract/S.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE CurseCauldron/Sec.en: There's only one thing more mysterious than a locked box...
Conversation/Moon CLUE CurseCauldron/Sec.pl: Jest tylko jedna rzecz bardziej tajemnicza niż zamknięta skrzynia...
Conversation/Moon CLUE CurseCauldron/Sec.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE CurseCauldron/Sec.en: ...and that's an [h]unlocked[/h] box that's been emptied of its contents.
Conversation/Moon CLUE CurseCauldron/Sec.pl: ...a jest nią [h]odblokowana[/h] skrzynia opróżniona ze swojej zawartości.
Conversation/Moon CLUE CurseCauldron/Sec.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE CurseCauldron/Sec.en: Did you ever come across the cauldron in your research?
Conversation/Moon CLUE CurseCauldron/Sec.pl: Natknęłaś się kiedyś na kocioł w swoich badaniach?
Conversation/Moon CLUE CurseCauldron/Sec.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Moon CLUE CurseCauldron/Sec.en: No... it really does seem to be something Mortuga's been keeping to himself.
Conversation/Moon CLUE CurseCauldron/Sec.pl: Nie... to naprawdę wygląda na coś, co Mortuga trzymał dla siebie.
Conversation/Moon CLUE CurseCauldron/Sec.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE CurseCauldron/Sec.en: What d'you make of those scratch marks?
Conversation/Moon CLUE CurseCauldron/Sec.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Moon CLUE CurseCauldron/Sec.en: I'm not sure. They don't really look like anything made by an animal...
Conversation/Moon CLUE CurseCauldron/Sec.pl: Nie jestem pewna. Nie wyglądają na zrobione przez zwierzę...
Conversation/Moon CLUE CurseCauldron/Sec.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE DivingLicense/Sec.en: Ah. I see what you did there.
Conversation/Moon CLUE DivingLicense/Sec.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE DreamHelmet/Secti.en: Mariana - I was wondering if you could tell us who's worn this?
Conversation/Moon CLUE DreamHelmet/Secti.pl: Mariano - zastanawiałem się, czy mogłabyś nam powiedzieć, kto to nosił?
Conversation/Moon CLUE DreamHelmet/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Moon CLUE DreamHelmet/Secti.en: How's she supposed to do that?
Conversation/Moon CLUE DreamHelmet/Secti.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Moon CLUE DriftwoodCane/Sec.en: The bandages in the centre smell of fearful sweat...
Conversation/Moon CLUE DriftwoodCane/Sec.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE DriftwoodCane/Sec.en: ...the wood itself - it's mahogany, but it smells of salty ocean air...
Conversation/Moon CLUE DriftwoodCane/Sec.pl: ...samo drewno - to mahoń, ale pachnie słonym morskim powietrzem...
Conversation/Moon CLUE DriftwoodCane/Sec.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE DriftwoodCane/Sec.en: ...and the little hat - smells like a dress worn by a doll.
Conversation/Moon CLUE DriftwoodCane/Sec.pl: ...a mały kapelusik - pachnie jak suknia noszona przez lalkę.
Conversation/Moon CLUE DriftwoodCane/Sec.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE FamilyPhoto/Secti.en: Oh, Good. I was worried this wasn't going to come up.
Conversation/Moon CLUE FamilyPhoto/Secti.pl: Och, dobrze. Martwiłam się, że to nie wypłynie.
Conversation/Moon CLUE FamilyPhoto/Secti.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE FamilyPhoto/Secti.en: The best part of this photo is the thing on the left-hand side...
Conversation/Moon CLUE FamilyPhoto/Secti.pl: Najlepsza część tego zdjęcia to rzecz po lewej stronie...
Conversation/Moon CLUE FamilyPhoto/Secti.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE FamilyPhoto/Secti.en: We might've. But what's it doing in the photo?
Conversation/Moon CLUE FamilyPhoto/Secti.pl: Może i tak. Ale co robi na zdjęciu?
Conversation/Moon CLUE FamilyPhoto/Secti.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Moon CLUE FamilyPhoto/Secti.en: So - that submarine in the background - the Silversnake is the reason that was built!
Conversation/Moon CLUE FamilyPhoto/Secti.pl: Więc - ta łódź podwodna w tle - Srebrny Wąż jest powodem, dla którego ją zbudowano!
Conversation/Moon CLUE FamilyPhoto/Secti.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE FamilyPhoto/Secti.en: Sylvia Seafoam, pictured there in the fancy jacket, she was quite fond of her serpent friend, you see-
Conversation/Moon CLUE FamilyPhoto/Secti.pl: Sylvia Seafoam, przedstawiona tam w wystawnej marynarce, bardzo lubiła swojego przyjaciela węża, rozumiecie-
Conversation/Moon CLUE FamilyPhoto/Secti.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE FamilyPhoto/Secti.en: So Sylvia made a plan to go and live in a submarine, and take the Silversnake [i]with[/i] her.
Conversation/Moon CLUE FamilyPhoto/Secti.pl: Więc Sylvia zaplanowała, że zamieszka na łodzi podwodnej i zabierze Srebrnego Węża [i]ze[/i] sobą.
Conversation/Moon CLUE FamilyPhoto/Secti.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE FamilyPhoto/Secti.en: -but the powers that be were demanding she hand it over to be studied.
Conversation/Moon CLUE FamilyPhoto/Secti.pl: -ale władze żądały, żeby go oddała do zbadania.
Conversation/Moon CLUE FamilyPhoto/Secti.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE FamilyPhoto/Secti.en: Wait - so the sea serpent would [h]also[/h] be living in the submarine?
Conversation/Moon CLUE FamilyPhoto/Secti.pl: Czekajcie - więc morski wąż [h]też[/h] miałby mieszkać na łodzi podwodnej?
Conversation/Moon CLUE FamilyPhoto/Secti.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Moon CLUE FamilyPhoto/Secti.en: Well, I don't have all the details - it's something I'm still researching.
Conversation/Moon CLUE FamilyPhoto/Secti.pl: Cóż, nie mam wszystkich szczegółów - wciąż to badam.
Conversation/Moon CLUE FamilyPhoto/Secti.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE FamilyPhoto/Secti.en: It's in a glass tank - do you see it?
Conversation/Moon CLUE FamilyPhoto/Secti.pl: Jest w szklanym zbiorniku - widzicie go?
Conversation/Moon CLUE FamilyPhoto/Secti.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE FamilyPhoto/Secti.en: It's the [h]Silver[/h]snake! Also known as the [i]Silkwirm Serpent.[/i]
Conversation/Moon CLUE FamilyPhoto/Secti.pl: To [h]Srebrny[/h] Wąż! Znany też jako [i]Wąż z Silkwirm.[/i]
Conversation/Moon CLUE FamilyPhoto/Secti.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE FeliciaPainting/S.en: This here - that's the Stonetop emblem.
Conversation/Moon CLUE FeliciaPainting/S.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE FeliciaPainting/S.en: We saw it on the sign outside the Stonetop Inn.
Conversation/Moon CLUE FeliciaPainting/S.pl: Widzieliśmy je na szyldzie przed Gospodą Stonetop.
Conversation/Moon CLUE FeliciaPainting/S.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Moon CLUE FeliciaPainting/S.en: No, but I was basically still asleep at that point.
Conversation/Moon CLUE FeliciaPainting/S.pl: Nie, ale w tamtym momencie właściwie wciąż spałam.
Conversation/Moon CLUE FeliciaPainting/S.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Moon CLUE FeliciaPainting/S.en: What are those letters above it?
Conversation/Moon CLUE FeliciaPainting/S.pl: Co to za litery nad nim?
Conversation/Moon CLUE FeliciaPainting/S.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Moon CLUE FilmProjector/Sec.en: [i]Close your eyes, my love, and be still. For this is the end and the beginning.[/i]
Conversation/Moon CLUE FilmProjector/Sec.pl: [i]Zamknij oczy, moja miłości, i znieruchom. Bo to jest koniec i początek.[/i]
Conversation/Moon CLUE FilmProjector/Sec.speaker: Film

Conversation/Moon CLUE FilmProjector/Sec.en: That's the voice I heard when I was in the bilge...
Conversation/Moon CLUE FilmProjector/Sec.pl: To głos, który słyszałam, kiedy byłam w zęzie...
Conversation/Moon CLUE FilmProjector/Sec.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE FilmProjector/Sec.en: At least I think it is - sounds a little different without all the echo.
Conversation/Moon CLUE FilmProjector/Sec.pl: Przynajmniej tak mi się wydaje - brzmi trochę inaczej bez tego całego echa.
Conversation/Moon CLUE FilmProjector/Sec.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE FogBall/Section d.en: If I'm not mistaken, this little part at the front... is actually a [i]microphone.[/i]
Conversation/Moon CLUE FogBall/Section d.pl: Jeśli się nie mylę, ta mała część z przodu... to właściwie [i]mikrofon.[/i]
Conversation/Moon CLUE FogBall/Section d.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE GlassEyeball/Sect.en: It carries something of the [i]cadaver[/i] about it...
Conversation/Moon CLUE GlassEyeball/Sect.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE GlassEyeball/Sect.en: Might be the [i]smell. Rust and stagnant seawater...[/i]
Conversation/Moon CLUE GlassEyeball/Sect.pl: Może to ten [i]zapach. Rdza i stojąca woda morska...[/i]
Conversation/Moon CLUE GlassEyeball/Sect.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE GlassEyeball/Sect.en: Perhaps it came from the ocean - have you asked Madam Tadpole about it?
Conversation/Moon CLUE GlassEyeball/Sect.pl: Może pochodzi z oceanu - pytaliście o to Madam Tadpole?
Conversation/Moon CLUE GlassEyeball/Sect.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE GoldenLocket/Sect.en: I thought Symmetry was supposed to be an impoverished orphan!
Conversation/Moon CLUE GoldenLocket/Sect.pl: Myślałam, że Symmetry miała być zubożałą sierotą!
Conversation/Moon CLUE GoldenLocket/Sect.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Moon CLUE GoldenLocket/Sect.en: Well, it's not worth anything unless she's willing to [i]sell[/i] it.
Conversation/Moon CLUE GoldenLocket/Sect.pl: Cóż, nie jest nic warte, dopóki nie zechce go [i]sprzedać.[/i]
Conversation/Moon CLUE GoldenLocket/Sect.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE HandheldRadio/Sec.en: I thought the submarine didn't [h]have[/h] a radio...
Conversation/Moon CLUE HandheldRadio/Sec.pl: Myślałam, że łódź podwodna nie [h]ma[/h] radia...
Conversation/Moon CLUE HandheldRadio/Sec.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE HandheldRadio/Sec.en: This is more like a child's walkie talkie.
Conversation/Moon CLUE HandheldRadio/Sec.pl: To bardziej wygląda na dziecięcy krótkofalówkę.
Conversation/Moon CLUE HandheldRadio/Sec.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Moon CLUE HandheldRadio/Sec.en: If it's a walkie talkie, then what happened to the other one?
Conversation/Moon CLUE HandheldRadio/Sec.pl: Jeśli to krótkofalówka, to co się stało z tą drugą?
Conversation/Moon CLUE HandheldRadio/Sec.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Moon CLUE HandheldRadio/Sec.en: Oh yes, you're quite right. Probably has a short range, too...
Conversation/Moon CLUE HandheldRadio/Sec.pl: O tak, macie rację. Pewnie ma też krótki zasięg...
Conversation/Moon CLUE HandheldRadio/Sec.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE HandwrittenLetter.en: These [i]diagrams[/i]... they're detailing the time and place to find the Mortuga submarine.
Conversation/Moon CLUE HandwrittenLetter.pl: Te [i]diagramy...[/i] szczegółowo opisują czas i miejsce, gdzie znaleźć łódź podwodną Mortuga.
Conversation/Moon CLUE HandwrittenLetter.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE HandwrittenLetter.en: Of course, it would be possible just to write it out in words, but this has been done with astronomy and lunar phases...
Conversation/Moon CLUE HandwrittenLetter.pl: Oczywiście, można by to po prostu opisać słowami, ale zrobiono to za pomocą astronomii i faz księżyca...
Conversation/Moon CLUE HandwrittenLetter.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE HandwrittenLetter.en: [i]My[/i] guess is that it's intended to incite [i]curiosity[/i] in the recipient.
Conversation/Moon CLUE HandwrittenLetter.pl: [i]Moim[/i] zdaniem ma to wzbudzić [i]ciekawość[/i] u odbiorcy.
Conversation/Moon CLUE HandwrittenLetter.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE HandwrittenLetter.en: It's more effective than if they'd just written [i]'come to this place at this time.'[/i]
Conversation/Moon CLUE HandwrittenLetter.pl: To skuteczniejsze, niż gdyby po prostu napisali [i]'przyjdź w to miejsce o tej porze'.[/i]
Conversation/Moon CLUE HandwrittenLetter.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE HandwrittenLetter.en: It feels less like a trap this way.
Conversation/Moon CLUE HandwrittenLetter.pl: W ten sposób wydaje się to mniej pułapką.
Conversation/Moon CLUE HandwrittenLetter.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE HexBottle/Section.en: But the liquid is saltwater, with a mix of herbs.
Conversation/Moon CLUE HexBottle/Section.pl: Ale płyn to woda morska, z mieszanką ziół.
Conversation/Moon CLUE HexBottle/Section.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE HexBottle/Section.en: I suppose Zephyr must have a pestle and mortar... I might ask to borrow it-
Conversation/Moon CLUE HexBottle/Section.pl: Zgaduję, że Zephyr musi mieć moździerz z tłuczkiem... może poproszę o pożyczenie-
Conversation/Moon CLUE HexBottle/Section.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE HexBottle/Section.en: I can't speak to what that is [i]squirming[/i] around in the bottle, there-
Conversation/Moon CLUE HexBottle/Section.pl: Nie potrafię powiedzieć, co to [i]wije się[/i] w tej butelce, tam-
Conversation/Moon CLUE HexBottle/Section.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE HexoftheHelmsman/.en: Pass it here, I'll show you something amusing.
Conversation/Moon CLUE HexoftheHelmsman/.pl: Podajcie mi to, pokażę wam coś zabawnego.
Conversation/Moon CLUE HexoftheHelmsman/.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE HexoftheHelmsman/.en: See this photograph on the inside cover?
Conversation/Moon CLUE HexoftheHelmsman/.pl: Widzicie to zdjęcie na wewnętrznej okładce?
Conversation/Moon CLUE HexoftheHelmsman/.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE HexoftheHelmsman/.en: It's a picture of Wirman, isn't it?
Conversation/Moon CLUE HexoftheHelmsman/.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Moon CLUE HexoftheHelmsman/.en: If it is... it's a [h]very[/h] flattering one.
Conversation/Moon CLUE HexoftheHelmsman/.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Moon CLUE HexoftheHelmsman/.en: Ha! It's not Wirman at all!
Conversation/Moon CLUE HexoftheHelmsman/.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE HexoftheHelmsman/.en: It's his rather more handsome father, Mayor Damian Dusk.
Conversation/Moon CLUE HexoftheHelmsman/.pl: To jego znacznie przystojniejszy ojciec, burmistrz Damian Dusk.
Conversation/Moon CLUE HexoftheHelmsman/.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE IllusionistPoster.en: Mariana - you visited Silkwirm before, didn't you?
Conversation/Moon CLUE IllusionistPoster.pl: Mariano - byłaś już wcześniej w Silkwirm, prawda?
Conversation/Moon CLUE IllusionistPoster.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Moon CLUE IllusionistPoster.en: Was Sym's magic show in the theatre back then?
Conversation/Moon CLUE IllusionistPoster.pl: Czy pokaz magiczny Sym był wtedy w teatrze?
Conversation/Moon CLUE IllusionistPoster.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Moon CLUE IllusionistPoster.en: No... when I passed through, the theatre wasn't showing [i]anything.[/i]
Conversation/Moon CLUE IllusionistPoster.pl: Nie... kiedy tamtędy przejeżdżałam, teatr nie wystawiał [i]niczego.[/i]
Conversation/Moon CLUE IllusionistPoster.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE IllusionistPoster.en: So - that must've been after Sym left... but before the Theatre had booked a new act.
Conversation/Moon CLUE IllusionistPoster.pl: Więc - to musiało być po tym, jak Sym odeszła... ale zanim teatr zarezerwował nowy występ.
Conversation/Moon CLUE IllusionistPoster.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Moon CLUE IllusionistPoster.en: This very poster was up on the walls, but they'd covered it with a banner that said [i]'Cancelled'[/i]
Conversation/Moon CLUE IllusionistPoster.pl: Właśnie ten plakat wisiał na ścianach, ale przykryli go banerem z napisem [i]'Odwołane'[/i]
Conversation/Moon CLUE IllusionistPoster.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE InnDeeds/Section.en: Where on Earth did you find [i]this??[/i]
Conversation/Moon CLUE InnDeeds/Section.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE InnDeeds/Section.en: I don't know, you two have all the luck...
Conversation/Moon CLUE InnDeeds/Section.pl: Nie wiem, wam dwojgu wszystko się udaje...
Conversation/Moon CLUE InnDeeds/Section.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE InnDeeds/Section.en: I spent a [i]year[/i] researching Silkwirm and never found anything this good.
Conversation/Moon CLUE InnDeeds/Section.pl: Spędziłam [i]rok[/i] na badaniu Silkwirm i nigdy nie znalazłam czegoś tak dobrego.
Conversation/Moon CLUE InnDeeds/Section.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE InnDeeds/Section.en: It's penned by Solomon Stonetop himself.
Conversation/Moon CLUE InnDeeds/Section.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE InnDeeds/Section.en: They say he built the Stonetop Inn with his own hands - and in doing so, he founded the town of Silkwirm-on-sea.
Conversation/Moon CLUE InnDeeds/Section.pl: Mówią, że zbudował Gospodę Stonetop własnymi rękami - i tym samym założył miasteczko Silkwirm nad Morzem.
Conversation/Moon CLUE InnDeeds/Section.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE IronBell/Section.en: It has the smell and feel of something that's been in the ocean for quite some [i]time...[/i]
Conversation/Moon CLUE IronBell/Section.pl: Ma zapach i wygląd czegoś, co przebywało w oceanie przez dłuższy [i]czas...[/i]
Conversation/Moon CLUE IronBell/Section.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE IronBell/Section.en: Only there's no evidence of it on the surface - no barnacles, no algae...
Conversation/Moon CLUE IronBell/Section.pl: Tylko że nie ma na to dowodów na powierzchni - żadnych pąkli, żadnych alg...
Conversation/Moon CLUE IronBell/Section.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE IronBell/Section.en: Or - maybe someone just cleaned it.
Conversation/Moon CLUE IronBell/Section.pl: Albo - może ktoś to po prostu wyczyścił.
Conversation/Moon CLUE IronBell/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Moon CLUE IronBell/Section.en: Maybe it's a type of metal that resists that kind of stuff.
Conversation/Moon CLUE IronBell/Section.pl: Może to rodzaj metalu odpornego na takie rzeczy.
Conversation/Moon CLUE IronBell/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Moon CLUE IronBell/Section.en: You know, if and when I make a mysterious observation-
Conversation/Moon CLUE IronBell/Section.pl: Wiecie, jeśli i kiedy dokonuję tajemniczej obserwacji-
Conversation/Moon CLUE IronBell/Section.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE IronBell/Section.en: -I'm not necessarily looking for [i]immediate logical explanations.[/i]
Conversation/Moon CLUE IronBell/Section.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE LifesizeDoll/Sect.en: So, does [h]everyone[/h] on this submarine keep a lifesize doll of themselves, or...?
Conversation/Moon CLUE LifesizeDoll/Sect.pl: Więc, czy [h]wszyscy[/h] na tej łodzi podwodnej trzymają lalkę naturalnej wielkości swojej podobizny, czy...?
Conversation/Moon CLUE LifesizeDoll/Sect.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE LifesizeDoll/Sect.en: I'm pretty sure it's just Sym.
Conversation/Moon CLUE LifesizeDoll/Sect.pl: Jestem całkiem pewien, że to tylko Sym.
Conversation/Moon CLUE LifesizeDoll/Sect.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Moon CLUE LifesizeDoll/Sect.en: I swear, if we find a room somewhere with dolls of everyone else, I am going to [h]freak out.[/h]
Conversation/Moon CLUE LifesizeDoll/Sect.pl: Przysięgam, jeśli znajdziemy gdzieś pokój z lalkami wszystkich pozostałych, [h]oszaleję.[/h]
Conversation/Moon CLUE LifesizeDoll/Sect.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Moon CLUE MermaidPainting/S.en: Ah... [i]now[/i] we're getting to it. The reason all of us are here, really.
Conversation/Moon CLUE MermaidPainting/S.pl: Ach... [i]teraz[/i] dochodzimy do sedna. Prawdziwego powodu, dla którego my wszyscy tu jesteśmy.
Conversation/Moon CLUE MermaidPainting/S.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE MermaidPainting/S.en: Did you ever stop and wonder - why here? Why this particular part of the coast?
Conversation/Moon CLUE MermaidPainting/S.pl: Zastanawialiście się kiedyś - dlaczego tutaj? Dlaczego akurat ta część wybrzeża?
Conversation/Moon CLUE MermaidPainting/S.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE MermaidPainting/S.en: It all stems from a single truth;
Conversation/Moon CLUE MermaidPainting/S.pl: Wszystko wywodzi się z jednej prawdy;
Conversation/Moon CLUE MermaidPainting/S.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE MermaidPainting/S.en: There's something hiding in the water. Something big.
Conversation/Moon CLUE MermaidPainting/S.pl: Coś ukrywa się w wodzie. Coś wielkiego.
Conversation/Moon CLUE MermaidPainting/S.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE MermaidPainting/S.en: Ah - now - it wasn't my intent to cause you any lasting unease...
Conversation/Moon CLUE MermaidPainting/S.pl: Ach - no cóż - nie było moim zamiarem wywołać u was trwały niepokój...
Conversation/Moon CLUE MermaidPainting/S.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE MermaidPainting/S.en: Look - we three, we're merely [i]tourists[/i] here - [i]passers by.[/i]
Conversation/Moon CLUE MermaidPainting/S.pl: Słuchajcie - my troje, jesteśmy tu jedynie [i]turystami[/i] - [i]przechodniami.[/i]
Conversation/Moon CLUE MermaidPainting/S.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE MermaidPainting/S.en: Take my advice; keep your [i]distance[/i] from all this - so you can still walk away at the end.
Conversation/Moon CLUE MermaidPainting/S.pl: Posłuchajcie mojej rady; trzymajcie [i]dystans[/i] od tego wszystkiego - żebyście na koniec wciąż mogli po prostu odejść.
Conversation/Moon CLUE MermaidPainting/S.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE MessageinaBottle/.en: Hm. That algae is still young...
Conversation/Moon CLUE MessageinaBottle/.pl: Hm. Te algi są jeszcze młode...
Conversation/Moon CLUE MessageinaBottle/.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE MessageinaBottle/.en: Meaning - the bottle's been in the [i]ocean...[/i] but not for all that long.
Conversation/Moon CLUE MessageinaBottle/.pl: Czyli - butelka była w [i]oceanie...[/i] ale nie aż tak długo.
Conversation/Moon CLUE MessageinaBottle/.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE ModelTown/Section.en: Do you recognise any of the little wooden people?
Conversation/Moon CLUE ModelTown/Section.pl: Rozpoznajesz kogoś z tych małych drewnianych ludzików?
Conversation/Moon CLUE ModelTown/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Moon CLUE ModelTown/Section.en: I believe [i]this[/i] is supposed to be Silkwirm's Governor - a man named Faustus Fellow.
Conversation/Moon CLUE ModelTown/Section.pl: Wierzę, że [i]to[/i] ma przedstawiać Gubernatora Silkwirm - człowieka imieniem Faustus Fellow.
Conversation/Moon CLUE ModelTown/Section.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE ModelTown/Section.en: He was a wealthy landowner who bought the town in order to bring it under his control.
Conversation/Moon CLUE ModelTown/Section.pl: Był bogatym posiadaczem ziemskim, który kupił miasteczko, żeby wziąć je pod swoją kontrolę.
Conversation/Moon CLUE ModelTown/Section.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE MoonVial/Section.en: Well, we just figured - since there's a moon drawn on the label...
Conversation/Moon CLUE MoonVial/Section.pl: Cóż, po prostu pomyśleliśmy - skoro na etykiecie jest narysowany księżyc...
Conversation/Moon CLUE MoonVial/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Moon CLUE MoonVial/Section.en: So because my name is [i]Moon[/i], all moon-related things must belong to me? Hm?
Conversation/Moon CLUE MoonVial/Section.pl: Więc skoro nazywam się [i]Moon,[/i] wszystkie rzeczy związane z księżycem muszą należeć do mnie? Hm?
Conversation/Moon CLUE MoonVial/Section.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE MoonVial/Section.en: Even if it's not yours, do you have any idea what it is?
Conversation/Moon CLUE MoonVial/Section.pl: Nawet jeśli to nie twoje, masz pojęcie, co to jest?
Conversation/Moon CLUE MoonVial/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Moon CLUE MoonVial/Section.en: It's a... herbal [i]compound[/i] of some kind. Valerian, skullcap, chamomile... and seawater.
Conversation/Moon CLUE MoonVial/Section.pl: To... jakiś ziołowy [i]związek.[/i] Kozłek lekarski, tarczyca, rumianek... i woda morska.
Conversation/Moon CLUE MoonVial/Section.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE MoonVial/Section.en: Maybe it's medicine. Would those herbs do anything in particular?
Conversation/Moon CLUE MoonVial/Section.pl: Może to lekarstwo. Czy te zioła robiłyby coś konkretnego?
Conversation/Moon CLUE MoonVial/Section.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Moon CLUE MoonVial/Section.en: Hm - I suppose it could be a [i]sleep aid[/i]. Like a mild sedative?
Conversation/Moon CLUE MoonVial/Section.pl: Hm - przypuszczam, że to może być [i]środek nasenny.[/i] Coś jak łagodny lek uspokajający?
Conversation/Moon CLUE MoonVial/Section.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE MovieMagazine/Sec.en: Where'd you get that? A dentist's waiting room?
Conversation/Moon CLUE MovieMagazine/Sec.pl: Skąd to masz? Z poczekalni u dentysty?
Conversation/Moon CLUE MovieMagazine/Sec.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE MovieMagazine/Sec.en: There's a poster on the back cover - it's for Dirk's movie.
Conversation/Moon CLUE MovieMagazine/Sec.pl: Na tylnej okładce jest plakat - to reklama filmu Dirka.
Conversation/Moon CLUE MovieMagazine/Sec.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Moon CLUE MovieMagazine/Sec.en: Huh. They've given her the wrong type of necklace...
Conversation/Moon CLUE MovieMagazine/Sec.pl: Huh. Dali jej niewłaściwy rodzaj naszyjnika...
Conversation/Moon CLUE MovieMagazine/Sec.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE MovieMagazine/Sec.en: The sword looks about right, though...
Conversation/Moon CLUE MovieMagazine/Sec.pl: Miecz wygląda za to całkiem nieźle...
Conversation/Moon CLUE MovieMagazine/Sec.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE NewspaperPage/Sec.en: This marks a pivotal moment in Silkwirm's history - the day the [i]Silversnake[/i] was discovered.
Conversation/Moon CLUE NewspaperPage/Sec.pl: To oznacza przełomowy moment w historii Silkwirm - dzień, w którym odkryto [i]Srebrnego Węża.[/i]
Conversation/Moon CLUE NewspaperPage/Sec.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE NewspaperPage/Sec.en: It also shows the two women who found it - [i]Felicia Stonetop[/i], that's her on the left, and [i]Sylvia Seafoam[/i] on the right.
Conversation/Moon CLUE NewspaperPage/Sec.pl: Pokazuje też dwie kobiety, które go znalazły - [i]Felicię Stonetop,[/i] to ona po lewej, i [i]Sylvię Seafoam[/i] po prawej.
Conversation/Moon CLUE NewspaperPage/Sec.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE NewspaperPage/Sec.en: Ha. Yes, well... that's [i]history[/i] for you.
Conversation/Moon CLUE NewspaperPage/Sec.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE NewspaperPage/Sec.en: But - on the statue, the serpent was shown being wrestled by a male fisherman...
Conversation/Moon CLUE NewspaperPage/Sec.pl: Ale - na posągu wąż był pokazany, jak zmaga się z nim rybak mężczyzna...
Conversation/Moon CLUE NewspaperPage/Sec.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Moon CLUE NewspaperPage/Sec.en: Hang on - we saw a statue about this in the town square...
Conversation/Moon CLUE NewspaperPage/Sec.pl: Czekajcie - widzieliśmy posąg o tym na rynku...
Conversation/Moon CLUE NewspaperPage/Sec.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Moon CLUE Pocketbook/Sectio.en: That's quite some book... did you take it from a [i]werewolf[/i], perhaps?
Conversation/Moon CLUE Pocketbook/Sectio.pl: To całkiem spora książka... zabraliście ją może [i]wilkołakowi?[/i]
Conversation/Moon CLUE Pocketbook/Sectio.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE Pocketbook/Sectio.en: Sniffing it and saying [i]'that explains it'[/i], does not, in fact, explain it!
Conversation/Moon CLUE Pocketbook/Sectio.pl: Wąchanie tego i mówienie [i]'to wszystko wyjaśnia'[/i] wcale, tak naprawdę, niczego nie wyjaśnia!
Conversation/Moon CLUE Pocketbook/Sectio.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Moon CLUE RaggedCloth/Secti.en: It's a piece of an old sail... roughly cut into a square.
Conversation/Moon CLUE RaggedCloth/Secti.pl: To kawałek starego żagla... z grubsza wycięty w kwadrat.
Conversation/Moon CLUE RaggedCloth/Secti.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE SeaChart/Section.en: As much as I [i]love[/i] an old map, I wouldn't know where to [i]start[/i] with this...
Conversation/Moon CLUE SeaChart/Section.pl: Choć [i]uwielbiam[/i] stare mapy, nie wiedziałabym, od czego [i]zacząć[/i] z tą...
Conversation/Moon CLUE SeaChart/Section.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE SeaChart/Section.en: I prefer maps that show some sort of land.
Conversation/Moon CLUE SeaChart/Section.pl: Wolę mapy, które pokazują jakiś rodzaj lądu.
Conversation/Moon CLUE SeaChart/Section.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE SeaChart/Section.en: Or, you know - some sort of [h]anything.[/h]
Conversation/Moon CLUE SeaChart/Section.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE ShipinaBottle/Sec.en: It's evident by the selection of little wooden people on board...
Conversation/Moon CLUE ShipinaBottle/Sec.pl: Widać to po doborze małych drewnianych ludzików na pokładzie...
Conversation/Moon CLUE ShipinaBottle/Sec.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE ShipinaBottle/Sec.en: What did they use it for?
Conversation/Moon CLUE ShipinaBottle/Sec.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Moon CLUE ShipinaBottle/Sec.en: Now, I'd have to assume this is the [i]Stonetop family[/i] ship - the [i]'Dearest Selena'.[/i]
Conversation/Moon CLUE ShipinaBottle/Sec.pl: No, musiałabym założyć, że to statek [i]rodziny Stonetop[/i] - [i]'Dearest Selena'.[/i]
Conversation/Moon CLUE ShipinaBottle/Sec.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE ShipinaBottle/Sec.en: How d'you know it's that ship? Is there a photo of it?
Conversation/Moon CLUE ShipinaBottle/Sec.pl: Skąd wiesz, że to ten statek? Jest jakieś jego zdjęcie?
Conversation/Moon CLUE ShipinaBottle/Sec.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Moon CLUE ShipinaBottle/Sec.en: The Dearest Selena was captained by [i]Felicia Stonetop[/i] - that's her there.
Conversation/Moon CLUE ShipinaBottle/Sec.pl: Dearest Seleną dowodziła [i]Felicia Stonetop[/i] - to ona tam.
Conversation/Moon CLUE ShipinaBottle/Sec.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE ShipinaBottle/Sec.en: What about the woman tied to the front?
Conversation/Moon CLUE ShipinaBottle/Sec.pl: A co z kobietą przywiązaną z przodu?
Conversation/Moon CLUE ShipinaBottle/Sec.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Moon CLUE ShipinaBottle/Sec.en: That's a representation of the ship's [i]figurehead.[/i]
Conversation/Moon CLUE ShipinaBottle/Sec.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE ShipinaBottle/Sec.en: Oh, I don't know, fishing? Tourism? General gallivanter?
Conversation/Moon CLUE ShipinaBottle/Sec.pl: Och, nie wiem, rybołówstwo? Turystyka? Ogólne włóczęgostwo?
Conversation/Moon CLUE ShipinaBottle/Sec.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE ShipinaBottle/Sec.en: And one [i]Magnus Mortuga[/i] was her helmsman.
Conversation/Moon CLUE ShipinaBottle/Sec.pl: A pewien [i]Magnus Mortuga[/i] był jej sternikiem.
Conversation/Moon CLUE ShipinaBottle/Sec.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE ShipsWheel/Sectio.en: The thicker wood is mahogany - very [h]old[/h] mahogany.
Conversation/Moon CLUE ShipsWheel/Sectio.pl: Grubsze drewno to mahoń - bardzo [h]stary[/h] mahoń.
Conversation/Moon CLUE ShipsWheel/Sectio.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE ShipsWheel/Sectio.en: The thinner wood... oh I don't know, some kind of cheap timber, perhaps?
Conversation/Moon CLUE ShipsWheel/Sectio.pl: Cieńsze drewno... och, nie wiem, może jakiś tani budulec?
Conversation/Moon CLUE ShipsWheel/Sectio.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE ShipsWheel/Sectio.en: Somebody skimped on the repairs, huh?
Conversation/Moon CLUE ShipsWheel/Sectio.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Moon CLUE SilkwirmMap/Secti.en: I see you've been enjoying my map.
Conversation/Moon CLUE SilkwirmMap/Secti.pl: Widzę, że cieszyliście się moją mapą.
Conversation/Moon CLUE SilkwirmMap/Secti.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE SilkwirmMap/Secti.en: It's - barely a map, it's closer to a [h]list.[/h]
Conversation/Moon CLUE SilkwirmMap/Secti.pl: To - ledwie mapa, bliżej jej do [h]listy.[/h]
Conversation/Moon CLUE SilkwirmMap/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Moon CLUE SilkwirmMap/Secti.en: What about the family tree on the back?
Conversation/Moon CLUE SilkwirmMap/Secti.pl: A co z drzewem genealogicznym z tyłu?
Conversation/Moon CLUE SilkwirmMap/Secti.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Moon CLUE SilkwirmMap/Secti.en: Most of my research into Silkwirm has been focused on these two family lines - the [i]Fellows[/i] and the [i]Stonetops.[/i]
Conversation/Moon CLUE SilkwirmMap/Secti.pl: Większość moich badań nad Silkwirm skupiała się na tych dwóch liniach rodzinnych - [i]Fellowach[/i] i [i]Stonetopach.[/i]
Conversation/Moon CLUE SilkwirmMap/Secti.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE SilkwirmMap/Secti.en: Seems like you haven't worked out how Mortuga fits into it...
Conversation/Moon CLUE SilkwirmMap/Secti.pl: Wygląda na to, że nie ustaliłaś, jak pasuje do tego Mortuga...
Conversation/Moon CLUE SilkwirmMap/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Moon CLUE SilkwirmMap/Secti.en: Hm... I'm not sure if he [h]does[/h] fit into it, to be honest.
Conversation/Moon CLUE SilkwirmMap/Secti.pl: Hm... szczerze mówiąc, nie jestem pewna, czy [h]w ogóle[/h] pasuje.
Conversation/Moon CLUE SilkwirmMap/Secti.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE SilkwirmMap/Secti.en: His name is just - floating out there by itself.
Conversation/Moon CLUE SilkwirmMap/Secti.pl: Jego imię po prostu - unosi się tam samotnie.
Conversation/Moon CLUE SilkwirmMap/Secti.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Moon CLUE SilkwirmMap/Secti.en: Mariana, you've got a question mark there. Someone you don't know the name of.
Conversation/Moon CLUE SilkwirmMap/Secti.pl: Mariano, masz tam znak zapytania. Ktoś, czyjego imienia nie znasz.
Conversation/Moon CLUE SilkwirmMap/Secti.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Moon CLUE SilkwirmMap/Secti.en: Ah, yes... [i]quite the mystery[/i], you see, I'd heard about-
Conversation/Moon CLUE SilkwirmMap/Secti.pl: Ach, tak... [i]spora zagadka,[/i] rozumiecie, słyszałam o-
Conversation/Moon CLUE SilkwirmMap/Secti.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE SilkwirmMap/Secti.en:
We know her name.
It's Freya.
Conversation/Moon CLUE SilkwirmMap/Secti.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Moon CLUE StrangeDevice/Sec.en: I... don't know what that is.
Conversation/Moon CLUE StrangeDevice/Sec.pl: Ja... nie wiem, co to jest.
Conversation/Moon CLUE StrangeDevice/Sec.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE SubmarineBlueprin.en: I'd love to know where Sinthia got the diagram of the wooden ship...
Conversation/Moon CLUE SubmarineBlueprin.pl: Chciałabym wiedzieć, skąd Sinthia ma diagram drewnianego statku...
Conversation/Moon CLUE SubmarineBlueprin.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE SubmarineBlueprin.en: I thought it was supposed to be a submarine.
Conversation/Moon CLUE SubmarineBlueprin.pl: Myślałam, że to miała być łódź podwodna.
Conversation/Moon CLUE SubmarineBlueprin.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Moon CLUE SubmarineBlueprin.en: No no - the yellowish parts - they're from an old drawing of a sailing ship?
Conversation/Moon CLUE SubmarineBlueprin.pl: Nie, nie - żółtawe fragmenty - pochodzą ze starego rysunku żaglowca?
Conversation/Moon CLUE SubmarineBlueprin.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE SubmarineBlueprin.en: Looks like it might be from the original, too. I just wonder where she got it.
Conversation/Moon CLUE SubmarineBlueprin.pl: Wygląda na to, że mogą być z oryginału. Zastanawiam się tylko, skąd je ma.
Conversation/Moon CLUE SubmarineBlueprin.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE SunTablets/Sectio.en: Mariana - can you tell us what these tablets are?
Conversation/Moon CLUE SunTablets/Sectio.pl: Mariano - możesz nam powiedzieć, czym są te tabletki?
Conversation/Moon CLUE SunTablets/Sectio.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Moon CLUE SunTablets/Sectio.en: Hm... it's rather more difficult when it's something synthetic like this.
Conversation/Moon CLUE SunTablets/Sectio.pl: Hm... to trochę trudniejsze, kiedy to coś syntetycznego jak to.
Conversation/Moon CLUE SunTablets/Sectio.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE SunTablets/Sectio.en: Some kind of vitamin supplement, I believe?
Conversation/Moon CLUE SunTablets/Sectio.pl: Jakiś rodzaj suplementu witaminowego, jak sądzę?
Conversation/Moon CLUE SunTablets/Sectio.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE SunTablets/Sectio.en: Yes... the three tablets seem, largely, to be the same thing.
Conversation/Moon CLUE SunTablets/Sectio.pl: Tak... te trzy tabletki wydają się, w dużej mierze, tym samym.
Conversation/Moon CLUE SunTablets/Sectio.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE Typewriter/Sectio.en: It's got a good example of the [i]Fellow emblem[/i], there on the back - see?
Conversation/Moon CLUE Typewriter/Sectio.pl: Ma na sobie dobry przykład [i]godła Fellowów,[/i] tam z tyłu - widzicie?
Conversation/Moon CLUE Typewriter/Sectio.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE UnderwaterPhoto/S.en: That [h]has[/h] to be a face... but it's not... it doesn't look like - like anyone...
Conversation/Moon CLUE UnderwaterPhoto/S.pl: To [h]musi[/h] być twarz... ale nie jest... nie wygląda jak - jak ktokolwiek...
Conversation/Moon CLUE UnderwaterPhoto/S.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE UnderwaterPhoto/S.en: So she's probably still out there...
Conversation/Moon CLUE UnderwaterPhoto/S.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE UnderwaterPhoto/S.en: Listen, don't worry about it. Seriously.
Conversation/Moon CLUE UnderwaterPhoto/S.pl: Słuchajcie, nie martwcie się tym. Poważnie.
Conversation/Moon CLUE UnderwaterPhoto/S.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sectio.en: I believe Mortuga used its light to alert others to the location of the submarine...
Conversation/Moon CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sectio.pl: Wierzę, że Mortuga używał jej światła, żeby powiadamiać innych o lokalizacji łodzi podwodnej...
Conversation/Moon CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sectio.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sectio.en: That's how it happened with us. Although, I guess it was Sinthia, not Mortuga.
Conversation/Moon CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sectio.pl: Tak właśnie stało się z nami. Chociaż, zgaduję, że to była Sinthia, nie Mortuga.
Conversation/Moon CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sectio.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Moon CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sectio.en: -on the rare occasions when he wished to [i]do[/i] such a thing, of course.
Conversation/Moon CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sectio.pl: -w rzadkich przypadkach, kiedy chciał [i]zrobić[/i] coś takiego, rzecz jasna.
Conversation/Moon CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sectio.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sectio.en: You know, for some [i]time[/i] now I've heard stories of sailors seeing a green light in the ocean at night...
Conversation/Moon CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sectio.pl: Wiecie, od jakiegoś [i]czasu[/i] słyszę historie żeglarzy widzących zielone światło w oceanie nocą...
Conversation/Moon CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sectio.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sectio.en: The problem is, several of the stories [i]predate[/i] the Mortuga Submarine...
Conversation/Moon CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sectio.pl: Problem w tym, że kilka z tych historii [i]poprzedza[/i] Łódź Podwodną Mortuga...
Conversation/Moon CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sectio.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sectio.en: Well, I guess you have your explanation.
Conversation/Moon CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sectio.pl: Cóż, zgaduję, że macie już swoje wyjaśnienie.
Conversation/Moon CLUE WoodenBuoy/Sectio.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Moon CLUE WoodenPipe/Sectio.en: What do you think of the pipe? Fine craftsmanship, wouldn't you say?
Conversation/Moon CLUE WoodenPipe/Sectio.pl: Co sądzicie o rurze? Świetne rzemiosło, nie powiedzielibyście?
Conversation/Moon CLUE WoodenPipe/Sectio.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE WoodenPipe/Sectio.en:
It's not a pipe at all!
It's a [i]secret dictaphone![/i]
Conversation/Moon CLUE WoodenPipe/Sectio.pl:
To wcale nie rura!
To [i]tajny dyktafon![/i]
Conversation/Moon CLUE WoodenPipe/Sectio.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Moon CLUE WoodenPipe/Sectio.en: Ahh, no, hang on, it might be useful.
Conversation/Moon CLUE WoodenPipe/Sectio.pl: Ach, nie, czekajcie, może się przydać.
Conversation/Moon CLUE WoodenPipe/Sectio.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Moon CLUE WoodenPipe/Sectio.en: You're clearly recording people without their permission.
Conversation/Moon CLUE WoodenPipe/Sectio.pl: Wyraźnie nagrywasz ludzi bez ich zgody.
Conversation/Moon CLUE WoodenPipe/Sectio.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Moon CLUE WoodenPipe/Sectio.en: Well - if you're going to kick up a fuss, I'll just take it back, shall I-
Conversation/Moon CLUE WoodenPipe/Sectio.pl: Cóż - jeśli macie zamiar robić z tego aferę, to po prostu to zabiorę z powrotem, dobrze-
Conversation/Moon CLUE WoodenPipe/Sectio.speaker: Moon

Conversation/Moon CLUE WoodenPipe/Sectio.en: Tut at me all you like, but you can't deny the value of hard evidence.
Conversation/Moon CLUE WoodenPipe/Sectio.pl: Cmokajcie na mnie, ile chcecie, ale nie możecie zaprzeczyć wartości twardych dowodów.
Conversation/Moon CLUE WoodenPipe/Sectio.speaker: Moon
